title: Get started with tidymedia
text: Codec: way compress audio video, H.264 AAC. FFmpeg names codec short string, "h264" "aac". Container: file format holds streams, MP4, MKV WAV. file extension usually names container. Stream: one track file, video one audio track. file can hold one stream kind. Encoder: part FFmpeg writes stream codec. One codec can several encoders, libx264 h264_videotoolbox H.264. Re-encode: decode stream write encoder. slower can lose quality, lets FFmpeg change picture sound. Stream copy: put stream output file without decoding . fast keeps quality, change picture sound. Pixel format: video stores color pixel, "yuv420p". Many players need "yuv420p" play H.264 video. Keyframe: video frame stored whole, change frames . stream copy can start cut keyframe. Frame rate: number video frames per second.  LUFS: unit loudness follows loud people hear sound. EBU R 128 broadcast standard uses -23 LUFS. True peak: highest level sound wave reaches, including samples. limit true peak stops sound clipping. Hardware encoder: encoder runs graphics card video chip instead main processor. NVIDIA nvenc Apple videotoolbox two tidymedia supports.
